reading: The Governor of the Bank of England has said regulating AI "is not the right place to start."
Instead, he called first for rigorous testing to find vulnerabilities and safeguards to contain risk.
Andrew Bailey said the risks around AI were real and increasingly significant.
Bailey believes AI development should not be halted, as the benefits are immense.
However, there must be a system for intervention and to establish boundaries for AI operation.
Recently, the debate about AI's potential risks has intensified.
Leading AI firm bosses have called for development to slow down and for a co-ordinated approach.
President Donald Trump rejected the idea of a slowdown, stating the US leads the AI race.
Later, Trump announced executives signed a "morally binding" document for protection from AI's potential risks.
Under this agreement, companies are responsible for ensuring the safety of their own technology.
In the UK, important work is underway in testing AI, which should help form part of a set of standards.
The pace of progress must accelerate, but with a degree of humility, the bank governor added.

vocabulary.definition: weaknesses or flaws that could be exploited or harmed.
measures or rules designed to protect someone or something from harm or danger.
becoming more and more important or noticeable over time.
the act of becoming involved in a difficult situation to improve it or prevent it from getting worse.
limits or borders that define where something can operate or what is allowed.
became stronger, more serious, or more extreme.

entries.ja: 非常に注意深く、徹底的で、正確なこと。
entries.zh-Hans: 非常仔细、彻底和精确的。

entries.ja: 利用されたり、害されたりする可能性のある弱点や欠陥。
entries.ko: 악용되거나 해를 입을 수 있는 약점이나 결함.
entries.zh-Hans: 可能被利用或受到损害的弱点或缺陷。
entries.es: Debilidades o fallos que podrían ser explotados o dañados.
entries.pt-BR: Fraquezas ou falhas que poderiam ser exploradas ou prejudicadas.
entries.fr: Faiblesses ou défauts qui pourraient être exploités ou endommagés.
entries.de: Schwachstellen oder Mängel, die ausgenutzt oder beschädigt werden könnten.

entries.ja: 誰かや何かを危害や危険から守るために考案された手段や規則。
entries.ko: 어떤 사람이나 사물을 해롭거나 위험한 것으로부터 보호하기 위해 고안된 조치나 규칙.
entries.zh-Hans: 旨在保护某人或某物免受伤害或危险的措施或规则。
entries.es: Medidas o reglas diseñadas para proteger a alguien o algo del daño o peligro.
entries.pt-BR: Medidas ou regras criadas para proteger alguém ou algo de danos ou perigos.
entries.fr: Mesures ou règles conçues pour protéger quelqu'un ou quelque chose du mal ou du danger.
entries.de: Maßnahmen oder Regeln, die dazu dienen, jemanden oder etwas vor Schaden oder Gefahr zu schützen.

entries.ja: 時間の経過とともに、ますます重要になったり、目立つようになったりしている状態。
entries.ko: 시간이 지남에 따라 점점 더 중요해지거나 눈에 띄게 되는.
entries.zh-Hans: 随着时间的推移变得越来越重要或引人注目。
entries.es: Que se vuelve cada vez más importante o notorio con el tiempo.
entries.pt-BR: Tornando-se cada vez mais importante ou perceptível com o tempo.
entries.fr: Devenir de plus en plus important ou perceptible au fil du temps.
entries.de: Mit der Zeit immer wichtiger oder auffälliger werdend.

entries.ja: 完全に停止した、または一時停止された状態。
entries.fr: Arrêté complètement ou mis en pause.

entries.ja: 困難な状況を改善するため、または悪化を防ぐために介入する行為。
entries.ko: 어려운 상황을 개선하거나 악화되는 것을 막기 위해 개입하는 행위.
entries.zh-Hans: 介入困境以改善或阻止其恶化的行为。
entries.es: El acto de involucrarse en una situación difícil para mejorarla o evitar que empeore.
entries.pt-BR: O ato de se envolver em uma situação difícil para melhorá-la ou evitar que piore.
entries.fr: L'acte de s'impliquer dans une situation difficile pour l'améliorer ou l'empêcher de s'aggraver.
entries.de: Das Eingreifen in eine schwierige Situation, um sie zu verbessern oder zu verhindern, dass sie sich verschlechtert.

entries.ja: 何かが機能できる範囲や、何が許容されるかを定める限界や境界線。
entries.ko: 무엇인가가 작동할 수 있는 범위나 허용되는 것을 정의하는 한계나 경계선.
entries.zh-Hans: 界定某事可以运作的范围或允许事项的限制或边界。
entries.es: Límites o fronteras que definen dónde puede operar algo o qué está permitido.
entries.pt-BR: Limites ou fronteiras que definem onde algo pode operar ou o que é permitido.
entries.fr: Limites ou frontières qui définissent le champ d'action ou ce qui est autorisé.
entries.de: Grenzen oder Begrenzungen, die festlegen, wo etwas operieren kann oder was erlaubt ist.

entries.ja: より強く、より深刻に、またはより極端になった状態。
entries.ko: 더 강해지거나, 더 심각해지거나, 더 극심해진.
entries.zh-Hans: 变得更强、更严重或更极端。
entries.es: Se hizo más fuerte, más serio o más extremo.
entries.pt-BR: Tornou-se mais forte, mais sério ou mais extremo.
entries.fr: Est devenu plus fort, plus sérieux ou plus extrême.
